meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 容器里会装上 mnemon,每次容器启动自动注册 Claude Code 钩子:Claude 回应前会调出相关记忆,每轮结束后写入新见解。记忆存在该 agent group 的 .claude/ 挂载里,容器重启后仍保留。
howto.when: 只适用于运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent group;若某个 group 的 container.json 里 provider 不是 claude(如 opencode),钩子不会运行。应用前需先确认 provider。

say.text: 帮我在容器里安装 mnemon 并开启持久记忆
检查这个 agent group 的 provider 是不是默认 Claude
say.note: 不是默认 Claude 的话钩子不生效

say.text: 开个新会话,提一下上次聊过的内容
say.note: mnemon 应自动调出相关上下文

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container image. On each start, mnemon setup registers Claude Code hooks: Claude recalls memory before responding and writes new insights after each turn. Memory persists in the mount across restarts.
howto.when_en: Applies only to agent groups on the default Claude provider. If a group's container.json sets another provider such as opencode, the mnemon hooks do not run.

say_en.text: Install mnemon in the container and turn on persistent memory
say_en.note: Edits the Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds

say_en.text: Check whether this agent group uses the default Claude provider
Start a new session and reference our earlier conversation
say_en.note: Memory should surface the context automatically
